title: Bayesian Anytime Pareto Set Identification for Multi-Objective Multi-Armed Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2606.18785v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Identifying Pareto optimal solutions is critical to support multi-objective decision-making. In this work, we present Top-Two Pareto Front Thompson Sampling (TTPFTS), the first anytime algorithm for Pareto Set Identification in Multi-Objective Multi-Armed Bandits (MOMABs), taking a Bayesian approach. We benchmark TTPFTS against state-of-the-art fixed-confidence and fixed-budget Pareto Set Identification algorithms on synthetic environments. Next, we demonstrate its practical utility in a challenging real-world multi-objective multi-agent molecular discovery setting by efficiently exploring an ultra-large synthesis-on-demand molecular library, outperforming industry-standard and state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, we introduce a novel uncertainty quantification metric that estimates our algorithm's confidence in the predicted Pareto set. tldr: 本文提出了首个基于贝叶斯的任意时间算法TTPFTS，用于多目标多臂老虎机中的帕累托集识别，并在真实分子发现任务中超越了行业标准与最先进的基线方法，同时引入了新型不确定性量化指标来评估算法对预测帕累托集的置信度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TTPFTS, the first Bayesian anytime algorithm for Pareto Set Identification in Multi-Objective Multi-Armed Bandits, which outperforms industry-standard and state-of-the-art baselines in real-world molecular discovery, along with a novel uncertainty quantification metric for estimating confidence in the predicted Pareto set.
